method.baseline: Complete, unmodified bounded ThumbnailPlaylistNeighborhood.swift from PR #132 at the pinned revision.
method.boundary: Both helpers compiled as a separate optimized IlliquidApp module; identical unmodified IlliquidCore support sources and benchmark driver.
method.memory_scope: Both versions already retain at most nine URLs and nine distance entries. This experiment measures construction time, not allocation counts, peak RSS, or a new asymptotic memory reduction.
method.sampling: Fresh processes in balanced AB/BA pairs. One untimed warmup per process. Independent calibration per variant, up to four retained trials targeting at least 80% of the requested interval, capped at 5000000 calls. Calibration is excluded from timed summaries.
method.scope: Synchronous neighborhood preparation only; no actor scheduling, decoding, rendering, full-app latency, or energy measurement.
method.timer: DispatchTime interval around repeated helper calls, output count consumption, and result destruction. Fixture creation, normalization, warmup, and exact output validation are outside the interval.
